content.value_statement: Julia teams often need help writing fast, type-stable, maintainable code. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code practical Julia guidance.
actual_capabilities: Guides Julia 1.10+ language features, type design, and multiple dispatch patterns.
Recommends package workflows using Pkg.jl, Project.toml, Manifest.toml, and PkgTemplates.jl.
Explains testing, benchmarking, documentation, and code quality tools for Julia projects.
Supports performance review using type stability, allocation analysis, profiling, and BenchmarkTools.jl.
Covers scientific computing, data science, machine learning, web API, and deployment libraries.
limitations: It provides guidance only and does not run Julia code by itself.
It may need current project files to give precise refactoring advice.
It cannot guarantee performance gains without benchmarks from the target environment.
It focuses on Julia and is not a general replacement for domain experts.

use_cases.title: Optimize Numerical Code
use_cases.description: Review a slow Julia function for type instability, allocations, and benchmark design.

use_cases.title: Create Package Structure
use_cases.description: Plan a Julia package with tests, documentation, formatting, and registration readiness.

use_cases.title: Design Dispatch APIs
use_cases.description: Shape type hierarchies and method boundaries for clear, composable Julia libraries.

prompt_templates.title: Review Julia Basics
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Julia code for readability, idiomatic style, and basic type stability. Explain each recommendation in plain language.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Package
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a Julia package structure for this project. Include tests, documentation, formatting, dependencies, and release preparation.

prompt_templates.title: Improve Performance
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this Julia workload for allocations, type instability, and dispatch issues. Propose benchmark steps and targeted changes.

prompt_templates.title: Architect Dispatch System
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multiple dispatch architecture for this domain. Include type hierarchy, method boundaries, extension points, and type piracy risks.

output_examples.input: Review a slow Julia data transformation.
output: Likely issue: unstable element types in intermediate collections.
Recommended action: benchmark the current path before changing data structures.
Expected result: fewer allocations and clearer type inference after refactoring.

output_examples.input: Plan a Julia package for a numerical solver.
output: Project layout includes source, tests, documentation, benchmarks, and examples.
Quality checks include formatting, Aqua.jl, JET.jl, and documentation tests.
Release plan includes compatibility bounds and General registry preparation.

best_practices: Provide representative inputs, performance goals, and current benchmark results.
Ask for type stability, allocation, and dispatch analysis before broad rewrites.
Keep package changes aligned with Pkg.jl workflows and JuliaFormatter BlueStyle.
anti_patterns: Do not ask for performance conclusions without benchmark context.
Do not edit Project.toml manually when Pkg.jl can manage dependencies.
Do not add methods to external types without checking type piracy risk.

faq.question: What Julia versions does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets Julia 1.10+ and modern ecosystem practices.

faq.question: Can it help optimize existing Julia code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can review type stability, allocations, dispatch design, and benchmark strategy.

faq.question: Does it create complete Julia packages?
faq.answer: It can plan package structure, tests, documentation, formatting, and release steps.

faq.question: Does it run benchmarks automatically?
faq.answer: No. It suggests benchmark workflows, but execution depends on the user's environment.

faq.question: Can it help with scientific computing libraries?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers common Julia libraries for linear algebra, optimization, statistics, data, and visualization.

faq.question: Is it useful with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. It is declared compatible with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
